question: How is what is attracted and impelled described as acted upon by supreme lord powers and Brāhmī and others?
premises: The object is attracted and impelled.
The powers of the supreme lord act upon it.
Brāhmī and other powers also act upon it.
inference: The attracted and impelled object is acted upon by the powers of the supreme lord and by Brāhmī and others.
plain_english: Attracted and impelled by the powers of the supreme lord and by Brāhmī and others.
